metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully applied 'Capitalize Every Word' to all text via Format > Text > Capitalize Every Word and saved with Ctrl+S.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text (Ctrl+A), navigate Format > Text menus, apply case transformations, and save documents.
metadata.explanation: Chains the original title-case goal with a new objective: set double line spacing for all content paragraphs. The getter downloads the docx, checks title case on all content paragraphs, then parses OOXML w:spacing elements to verify each content paragraph has w:line='480' with w:lineRule='auto' (the OOXML encoding for double spacing). The initial document has no explicit spacing, so both checks fail as negative controls. After applying Capitalize Every Word + double spacing to all paragraphs, both pass for full credit (0.5 each).

scoring_breakdown.title_case_applied: 0.5 - All words in every content paragraph start with uppercase
scoring_breakdown.all_double_spacing: 0.5 - All content paragraphs have double line spacing (w:line=480, w:lineRule=auto)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks title case by verifying w[0].isupper() for every word in every content paragraph, matching the instruction requirement.
Getter correctly checks double line spacing using OOXML w:spacing w:line='480' with w:lineRule in ('auto', None), which is the standard LibreOffice encoding for double spacing.
Postconfig includes Ctrl+S + 2s sleep to ensure the file is saved and flushed before the getter reads it.
Metric function correctly applies 0.5 partial credit for each sub-goal (title case and double spacing), covering both instruction requirements.
Negative control resistance is sound: the initial document has no explicit paragraph-level double spacing, so the all_double_spacing check will fail on the unmodified file.
Error handling correctly returns error dict on missing file and returns all_double=False when no content paragraphs exist.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Double spacing set via paragraph style inheritance (not direct paragraph XML) would not be detected since the getter checks pPr.find(qn('w:spacing')) at the paragraph level only. Consider also checking the applied paragraph style's spacing if pPr or w:spacing is absent. This is unlikely to affect real-world evaluations since the typical LibreOffice workflow writes directly to paragraph XML.
